for: Quarterdeck build PR 5, C-8 Pages: list, viewer, make public (the ruling, the ruling, the ruling, the ruling; previews p1-make-public.txt, p2-pages-list.txt, p3-page-viewer.txt)
author: Quarterdeck contributors
how: Example data. 'pages' gives, for each example Page, the fields the Pages list and the Page viewer need beyond what the example data has: 'laneId', 'pinned', 'public', and for PG-2 and PG-3 a 'file' and 'versions'. Merge by ref; every field not given stays as in the example data. A 'laneId' of null prints 'no Lane'.

PG-1 (Mission control) is given only 'laneId' null, 'pinned' true and 'public' null. Its file and its text are the example data's own and are not copied, restated or edited here; item 6 writes its newer version. This item refers to PG-1 by id only.

PG-2 (Search results layout, Dr. Kivo) gets a file, so once it is merged alba-1's Evidence shows 'See all on Page': its Page tile stops reading 'No file yet'. The Page is in Lane l-sea (Search), private, version 2 current, last updated Mon 7:00 AM.

PG-3 (Bridge runbook, Shelvorn) gets a file and a newer version. Version 1 (Sun 3:00 PM) was made public by the Captain on Sun at 5:30 PM, so it carries the Public mark. Version 2 was made Mon 9:35 AM and is private. 'updatedAt' of PG-3 moves from Sun 3:00 PM to Mon 9:35 AM (the example data's own value is kept as 'updatedAtWas'); nothing else in the content files mentions it.

One newer version waiting: the Captain opened PG-3 at version 1 at 9:20 AM ('captainOpened'); version 2 landed at 9:35 AM. At 'now' his viewer shows 'Version 2 is ready. Show' and the version he is reading stays until he taps Show. The same fact gives 'Version 2 is newer and still private. Update public version' next to the Public mark.

Pinned: PG-1 only. Live: PG-1 only (from the example data). Public: PG-3 only. 'listViews' is the Pages list as the phone and the Mac table show it, newest first with pinned on top, and 'headers' is the viewer's head for each Page; the words are suggestions from the flow and the design lead's call.

Local files: pages/search-results-layout.html (PG-2 version 2), pages/bridge-runbook.html (PG-3 version 2) and pages/bridge-runbook-v1.html (PG-3 version 1). Each is plain local HTML with no comment and no outside request, in B's dark colours. PG-2 version 1 is not kept as a file ('kept' false).

The make-public card 'dr-kivo-2' is one Task Card in the example data's taskCards shape; merge it into taskCards by id. 'queueAdd' is its queue[] entry (append). Dr. Kivo asks to make PG-2 version 2 public, for a tester. Only the Captain can make a Page public, so it is a one-way card: option A is the one-way pick with the risk in plain words, option B keeps the Page private. 'makePublic' names the exact version and holds the confirm the Captain sees after he picks A. Its 'evidenceAdd' is the exact public version's preview: a picture of the Page file in B's dark colours (media/pg-2-v2-public-preview-phone.png).

Calls made here, the content lead's and the design lead's to change: (a) the card has options A and B like the tested one-way card F-1, not the flow's Approve and Reject buttons, so the one-way block, the risk and 'Send A? This cannot be undone.' come from the existing rules; (b) priority P2, due Thu Nov 5 5 PM (as the flow draws it), no task unblocked, in Lane l-sea because PG-2 is in it; the card adds no blocker and no Activity line to that Lane.

'queueAfter' restates the Queue for 11 waiting cards by the strict rule (priority, then task-only unblocks high to low, then soonest due, no due last; the design spec) and every count that follows it: the Queue head, the sidebar count, 'N of 11 in the Queue' on each card, and the waiting counts per Lane and per Project. It replaces item 4's 10-card table, which already holds the Join card.

Times: PG-2 and PG-3 times, the card (Mon 9:30 AM) and the preview (Mon 9:28 AM) are at or before now. Every bot act here is at or before that bot's last-active time in bots.json (Dr. Kivo 9:55 AM, Shelvorn 9:40 AM), so item 4 does not change.

card.title: Make "Search results layout" public?
card.about: Dr. Kivo asks to share a Page publicly.
card.context:
The Page shows how Search groups its results.
A tester outside the team needs to read it.
Only you can make a Page public.
card.ascii:
Search results layout, version 2
 ------------------------------------------
 Chats          3 results
 Task Cards    12 results    5 shown
 Projects       2 results
 Lanes          1 result
 Anyone with the link would see this Page.

options.label: A. Make version 2 public
options.does: Anyone with the link can read and copy version 2 of this Page, without signing in.
options.risk: Anyone with the link can read and copy it, and copies cannot be recalled. It is not sent to search engines.
options.undo: Cannot be undone. You can make the Page private again, but copies already made stay.
pros: The tester can read it today.
cons: Version 3 and later stay private until you update the public version.

options.label: B. Keep it private
options.does: The Page stays private; only people signed in to Quarterdeck can open it.
options.risk: The tester cannot read the layout yet.

card.pick_why: The tester needs a link without signing in, and the host found no private data in this version.
card.you_do: Open the public preview, then pick A or B.
card.skip: If no answer by due: the Page stays private and the tester waits.
